value.rationale: The underlying sharp L2-to-L4 extension theorem motivates the exact local stability invariant. The four-band real/imaginary axis/mixed spectral splitting, optimal gap and row-plus-column least-stable family distinguish the recoverable second-order geometry in every odd field. A nondegenerate Hessian is not automatic from uniqueness of maximizers, and these precise arithmetic curvature values can guide quantitative stability estimates.
